done_when: forge close skips the test run, as it does for docs-only changes, when the change touches only forge.toml, docs, plans, Markdown or Forge's records, and says so in one line naming the command it did not run. A command-level test closes a forge.toml-only change without running the test command.

findings.body: This test also changes `docs/settings.md`, so it exercises a mixed settings-and-docs change rather than the forge.toml-only case explicitly required by Done-when. No other reviewed test proves that case. Remove the docs change, or parameterize the test to include a settings-only case, retaining the successful-close, absent execution log, and single-line command announcement assertions. The automatic Forge record created by `tests/test_close.py:184` is permitted bookkeeping.
findings.title: Not done: a command-level test closes a forge.toml-only change without running the test command

why: A change that only edits forge.toml still waits for and runs the whole test suite at close, though it changes no code; CI runs the suite anyway
